skill_followability.followed: Every applicable instruction was followed as written: the saved file itself was opened and inspected (not a thumbnail or a tool result), characters and features were counted in the opened file, sides were converted out loud, and only what was seen is reported, with the file named.
insufficiencies: The skill contains no procedure for verifying a single still portrait against a written element-by-element spec: its portrait guidance is 'open the file and count what is in it' plus workflow sections (concept approval, character sheets, clip sampling, circular crop). The per-element verdict taxonomy used in this run (present as specified / present but deviating / absent) came from the run brief, not from the skill text.

The side-conversion rule ('convert sides out loud') appears only in the character-sheet section. Nothing in the portrait path tells a verifier to convert character side vs viewer side; this run had to import the rule across sections to check the right-ear cuff.

Qualitative spec terms ('at rest', 'slim', 'luminous') have no definitions or tests in the skill; verdicts on those qualifiers rest on plain-language judgement, which the skill neither sanctions nor forbids. The wing 'at rest' deviation is recorded on that basis and flagged for the record-keeper's ruling.
The skill instructs checking the listing where the avatar appears separately from the file; no listing check was in this run's brief, so that instruction was noted, not performed.
skill_followability.verdict: Followable as written for its core discipline; insufficiently specific for this task shape
